title: Supply Planning Intern
description:
Supply Planning Intern
This role has been designated as ‘Hybrid’ with an expectation that you will work on average 2-3 days per week from an HPE office.

Responsibilities:
Execute the demand and supply matching activities, connecting planning to execution, and identifying issues and their impact.
Translate demand and supply signals to estimated material wait time and deal simulation supportability result
identify opportunities for process improvement and develops recommendations.
Drives Shortage root cause analysis and preventive actions
Knowledge and Skills:
Good understanding of supply chain processes (plan, source, make deliver).
Excellent analytical skills.
Excellent communication and influencing skills; mastery in English and local language.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
Able to commit a minimum of 20 weeks from January 2024
